name: Blocked user gets 403 when creating new commitment (POST)
fullName: ../.features-gen/e2e-tests/bdd/features/consent-module.feature.spec.js › Consent Module › Blocked user gets 403 when creating new commitment (POST)

steps.name: Given a consent-blocked user with a valid session
When the blocked user sends POST to "/partnership-opportunity" with an empty body
Then the response status should be 403

expected 403; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-11-05T09:10:43.725870117","status":403,"error":"Forbidden","message":"You must accept the updated terms to continue using the platform","path":"/api/partnership-opportunity","code":"error.auth.consent_required","requestId":"REQ-88e3f166"}
And the response should have header "x-consent-required"
headers: vary, x-request-id, x-consent-required, x-content-type-options, x-xss-protection, cache-control, pragma, expires, x-frame-options, content-type, content-length, date, keep-alive, connection
